findings.title: Retain confirmed commit state when the original publisher fails before its annotated catch
findings.problem: After the original installer returns a confirmed COMMITTED_UNPUBLISHED completion, publishFresh35CombinedRecord can throw a plain Error during trust checks, existing-record detection or lstat errors, before its publishInstallationRecord catch. The new main does not retain the known completion phase. productionEntryFailure then returns exitCode1/installState null, violating the new entry contract for committed-but-unpublished failures.
findings.testGap: Author publicationFails stub preattaches installState COMMITTED_UNPUBLISHED, unlike these original publisher preflight exceptions.
findings.minimumCorrection: In the new entry post-completion publication phase, preserve COMMITTED_UNPUBLISHED for bare failures. Preserve an existing more specific PUBLISHED_DURABILITY_UNKNOWN classification. Do not retry, republish, change the original publisher/lifecycle or widen authority. Add only affected entry/test regression cases.
findings.limits: No wrong record, replay, secret leak or PG corruption demonstrated. The failure is loss of confirmed postcommit state/incorrect exit category.
